observation: A sudden host filesystem allocation occurred during AutoRound huge 96k capture. The 150 GiB reserve and 4 GiB total-growth guard had not triggered; the same controller remained active.

possible_source.status: Recent mtime observed; no prior allocated-block baseline. Causation is not proven. No recently modified regular files larger than 64 MiB found inside this mounted filesystem.

checks: No download-related process found besides the diagnostic grep itself. Experiment and Docker container logs did not explain the multi-GiB change. Subsequent free space was stable apart from small background writes. No files or services were modified by this investigation.
interpretation: Retain the response without replay. Record this background host-storage activity when interpreting latency; do not claim a completely isolated host benchmark or attribute the allocation to the experiment without evidence.
